sources.claim: At participating Post Offices, the PO Box "Street Addressing" option lets a box holder use the Post Office street address with the box number, so private carriers that need a street address can deliver; availability varies by location and the customer signs an agreement.

Example of a state rule (Washington): the registered agent address must be a physical street address in the state where the agent can accept service; PO Boxes and private or virtual mailboxes may not be used for it, though a PO Box may be listed as a separate mailing address. Other states have their own rules.
